rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 Objective 2 Game Play 2.1 Reflection 2.2 Echo 2.3 Nightmare 3 Game End 4 Scoring Objective Create up to 2 dreams (each row is a dream) and the player with the highest point at the end wins. Game Play Start or add a card to an existing dream. 2 dreams maximum. You can add a card if it matching the previous card in color (environment) or symbol (category). Draw back up to 3 cards from the River. Reflection When the symbol or color of the card you have just placed matches the one(s) directly across (in the same column) from your OTHER dream (Reflection), you move up the Reflection Track. If both color AND symbol are matched, you move up the track by 2. Moving up the Reflection Track gain you extra points AND, if you get to the end of the track, you instantly win the game. Echo An Echo is when you place a card that matches another card in the same dream EXACTLY (both color AND symbol). They do not need to be next to each other. When you triggered an Echo, you can play another card immediately. Nightmare If you cannot place a card, you can play one face down (nightmare). When you have a nightmare, you steal a card from your opponent instead of refilling your hand from the river. Your opponent will refill their hand from the River. Game End When someone reached the end of the track and instantly wins the game; or When the draw deck runs out and all cards are placed. Scoring Calculate separately for each dream your highest count of one color x highest count of 1 symbol and sum them up. Player with the higest points wins.

---

On your turn, you must:

1 - Play a card from your hand (triggering its effects)

2 - Replenish your hand to 3 cards from the river

The game ends:

Either when a player reaches the Wake-up space and that player wins the game!

Or when there are no more cards in either the draw pile or the river. All players continue to play their cards in hand. If a player can no longer start or continue one of their dreams, they pass their turn (instead of playing). When all players have passed, proceed to the scoring.

Your final score is the sum of the following 3 scores:
For the first Dream, multiply the most frequent Environment by the most frequent Category.
For the second Dream, do the same.
Add the Reflections track.
And the highest score wins!

[Rating: 3/10] In this card game, players take turns - mostly adding a card onto 1 of the 2 rows in their tableau, may gain points, then gain a card (draw or steal via nightmare) . Each placement is must match either a color or icon of a prior card, otherwise nightmare occurs where the player steals and card played is flipped over. If the same number of cards are in either row, if the compared cards placed gains 1 point if icon or color matches.  Player continues until draw deck runs out and the player with the most wins.
